Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Gupta, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Manoj Kumar Gupta with the prayer to quash charge sheet dated 16.11.2022 as well as cognizance order dated 24.11.2022 also taken on charge sheet in Case No. 227001 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No. 20 of 2022, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,120B I.P.C. and 66 I.T. Act Police Station Cyber Crime, District Varanasi, and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of aforesaid case, pending in the court of C.J.M., Varanasi, during pendency of the present application.

sentences.text: At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant states that the purpose of the applicant would suffice if an order is passed directing the trial court to decide the bail application of the applicant, as expeditiously as possible.
He further states that although the prayer has been made for quashing of the charge sheet and the cognizance order in the case but he does not press the same.
He further states that the applicant shall raise all the objections before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
Learned counsel for the State has no objection of aforesaid arguments of learned counsel for the applicant.
In view of the above, the prayer for quashing of cognizance order/charge sheet is dismissed as not pressed.

However, in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the limited prayer of learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that if the accused-applicant surrenders before the trial court and applies for bail within three weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
It it clarified that if the accused-applicant does not appear before the court concerned by the said date, the court concerned shall proceed against him in accordance with law.
The present application is disposed of.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Naresh  Ankit Bharadwaj vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28194600/
